final: WITH player_averages AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.bats, AVG(bp.double) AS avg_doubles FROM batting_postseason AS bp JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = bp.player_id WHERE p.bats IS NOT NULL AND p.bats <> '' GROUP BY p.player_id, p.bats), indexed AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, avg_doubles / (SELECT AVG(avg_doubles) FROM player_averages) AS player_index FROM player_averages), compared AS (SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, player_index, player_index - AVG(player_index) OVER (PARTITION BY bats) AS index_minus_hand_avg FROM indexed) SELECT player_id, bats, avg_doubles, player_index, index_minus_hand_avg FROM compared ORDER BY index_minus_hand_avg DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
